product_metadata.title: Party Essentials Deluxe/Elegance Quality Plastic 6-Ounce Fruit/Nut/Dessert Bowls, Clear, 20 Count
features: Package of 20 Northwest Enterprises deluxe quality plastic 6-ounce bowls; perfect for desserts or fruit; bowls are available in both black and clear
Classic styling; graceful fluted design with diamond-cut accents; hand washable; reusable; disposable
Matching deluxe dessert, salad and luncheon plates, salad bowls, rectangular appetizer plates and crystal clear plastic tumblers are also available
Ideal for catering, food service, picnics, weddings, buffets, family reunions and everyday use
From dinnerware, cutlery and cups to serve ware, table covers and more, Northwest Enterprises has just the right party essentials available on Amazon
description: Setting a table is really all about setting a mood, which is why Northwest Enterprises is committed to offering high quality, heavy duty disposable plastic tableware with an upscale look and feel at an affordable price. Northwest Enterprises' Pretty little 6-ounce bowls do, indeed, have a lovely appearance with their gently fluted edges and elegant cut-crystal look accents. And they're hand-washable, so they can make several memorable appearances on your table. So, whether it's a wedding, a simple neighborhood get together or easy-cleanup everyday use, choosing Northwest Enterprises will create the perfect mood at the perfect price. Northwest Enterprises is a traditional family company with more than 25 years of experience in party supplies and food service disposables. Through their dedication to the high quality of their products and services, Northwest Enterprises continues to earn a reputation as a leader in the party industry and the trust and loyalty of their customers.
